entities.summary: Jannatul Ferdoush Peya, also known as Peya Jannatul, is a Bangladeshi model and lawyer. She was crowned Miss Bangladesh 2007 and Indian Princess International 2013. Peya represented Bangladesh at Top Model of The World 2013 in Egypt where she placed in the top 15.
